surface: Source port of react-hook-form 7.88.0 at 28334faa6105b0475060592c6bf27dca87e3941e. Includes ErrorMessage, FieldArray, FormState and its FormStateSubscribe compatibility alias, getErrors, function form actions, native File/FormData, validation, schema resolvers, subscription and reconnect behavior. Retains all upstream runtime and type registrations with 1,364 pristine Jest executions, 1,355 adapted DOM/server cases, and an explicit 90-case browser crosswalk (87 native cases; three React MUI integrations inapplicable).
divergences: `register()` returns `onInput` (octane's native per-keystroke event) instead of React's synthetic `onChange`; mode names and `register` option keys keep the upstream spelling.

The structured parity ledger records native no-op input delivery, microtask batching, duplicate resolver notification, async act flush, reset render-count, and eager `Object.is` bailout differences with executable case identities, consumer impact, and migration guidance; the adapted DOM/server suite contains no skipped or expected-failure cases.

Three original browser registrations mount React MUI components and assert their portal DOM. No Octane MUI binding exists; those external integrations remain inapplicable and visible in the full case crosswalk.
ssr: Supported: adapted server markup checks plus hydration node adoption, server-effect exclusion, client values, and teardown.
